utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive needs? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure on the repairs yet, but I do want to pin down the timing and who’s bringing what first. Can we confirm the date, start time, and the rest of the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. Just point me to what needs doing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send you the updated list and timing, and the drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll keep the plan clear and send the final list and timing as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — appreciate it. Send me the final details when they’re set, and I’ll pass them along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check that for you—what details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye — I just need the list and timing for the repair drive so I can pass it along to everyone. Once Eli finalizes those details, I’ll help keep the neighborhood in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — I’m just helping folks pick tasks. If you’ve got a minute, could you bring tools or help set up a table?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring tools and help set up the table. Just tell me where you want me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’m still in for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Leo — I’ve got you down, and I’m still keeping track of the supplies list. If you can, bring any tools or extra tape you have handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’ve got my tools ready if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep an eye out for any updates and let you know if the repair drive shifts. Appreciate you being ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam — can you bring your basic tool kit and a few spare screws? If you can help patch the loose fence panel, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I’m keeping an eye on it too. Let me know if the date, location, or needed supplies change.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’ll actually spread the word about the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’ll spread the word and pass along a few ways people can help too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’ve mostly heard bits second-hand, so I may be missing details, but I can help figure out who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — that’d help a lot. I can keep it quiet on my end and just handle a few practical pieces.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll holler if I need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem at all — just holler anytime, and I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and about.
